edits.js: const e = document.querySelectorAll(".pager button")[0]; if (e) { const c = e.cloneNode(true); for (const n of c.querySelectorAll('*')) if (!n.children.length && n.textContent.trim()) n.textContent = "Pin"; if (!c.children.length) c.textContent = "Pin"; c.setAttribute('aria-label', "Pin"); e.parentNode.appendChild(c); }
